# Draft:United States invasion of Greenland

On [DATE], the United States invaded Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark.
Prior to the invasion, the United States under the administration of Donald Trump repeatedly reiterated plans to acquire Greenland, including by military force. As Greenland is a territory of Denmark, any military action taken would allow a response by NATO, which both the United States and Denmark are a part of.
